plugins.name: ara-business-pulse
plugins.description: ARA's morning Chief-of-Staff routine: read the ARA mailboxes (full) plus Gmail/iCloud (known-senders only) and iMessage (read-only, known contacts), with calendar and Dropbox; produce a one-page business pulse; draft (never send) nudges to allow-listed business domains only; post one Teams digest.

plugins.name: woodgrain
plugins.description: A late-1970s home-console look for the Claude desktop and mobile apps, in warm clay, ivory and slate: a chunky pixel-art scene with a sunburst and scanlines, and an 8-bit chime.
